description: This header file declares internal APIs for a CCSP CWMP SoapParser Object used within the CWMP protocol implementation. It contains function prototypes for building SOAP requests, processing SOAP responses and faults, handling SOAP envelopes, and utility functions for managing SOAP headers and parsing XML nodes.
